Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the cardholder involved in a transaction.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Cardholder name associated with the card.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language selected for the cardholder interface during the transaction.|Reference ISO 639-1 (alpha-2) et ISO 639-2 (alpha-3).

BillingAddress.name: Billing Address
BillingAddress.definition: Postal address of the owner of the payment card.

ShippingAddress.name: Shipping Address
ShippingAddress.definition: Postal address for delivery of goods or services.

Vehicle.name: Vehicle
Vehicle.definition: Information related to the vehicle used for the transaction.

Authentication.name: Authentication
Authentication.definition: Method and data intended to be used for this transaction to authenticate the cardholder and its card.

TransactionVerificationResult.name: Transaction Verification Result
TransactionVerificationResult.definition: Result of performed verifications for the transaction.

PersonalData.name: Personal Data
PersonalData.definition: Identifies personal data related to the cardholder.

MobileData.name: Mobile Data
MobileData.definition: Data related to the mobile of stakeholder.
